description: Replace insecure string comparison operators with constant-time comparison functions for authentication token validation across the codebase. This security enhancement prevents timing attacks that could allow attackers to guess authentication tokens character by character.
functional_requirements: Replace all `!=` string comparisons used for authentication token validation with `hmac.compare_digest()`
Update the basic authentication middleware to use constant-time comparison for API token validation
Update CSRF token validation middleware to use constant-time comparison for token matching
Update WebSocket authentication token validation to use constant-time comparison for subscription tokens
